assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A production sprite atlas for StepQuest, original fantasy pixel-art achievement medallions. EXACTLY SIX columns and FOUR rows, 24 equal square cells in a regular perfectly aligned grid, landscape 3:2 canvas ideally 1536x1024. Each cell contains exactly ONE centered complete emblem with generous clear transparent margins, all emblems same apparent size about 70 percent of cell width, never touching cell boundaries. No grid lines. Transparent background throughout gaps and around every medallion. Detailed crisp classic 32-bit JRPG pixel clusters, antique bronze, aged gold, emerald enamel and tiny amber lights. These are tangible keepsakes with distinct strong silhouettes, not generic circles with symbols. Exact row-major order: row1: 1 an open stone gateway with one footprint; 2 a pair of plain leather travelling boots; 3 the same boots with stitched patches and forest dust; 4 the same boots embroidered with a small golden compass; 5 a winding trail made of seven stepping stones beneath sunrise; 6 a circular wreath holding FIVE tiny amber lanterns. Row2: 1 a constellation forming a winding road in midnight-blue enamel; 2 a wooden walking staff with a green ribbon and pine twig; 3 two travelling footprints beneath one bronze lantern; 4 a wax-sealed letter with two small feather wings; 5 a copper wagon wheel with a blue gemstone hub; 6 a worn silver ferryman coin embossed with one turquoise wave. Row3: 1 an antique compass with THREE luminous directions; 2 a folded parchment map with TEN tiny brass pins; 3 three interlocking wax seals showing caravan wheel, mountain and river; 4 an old oak branch enclosing a tiny amber lantern; 5 an old oak branch tied with a crimson ribbon; 6 a shard of amber glass inside a weathered beacon-tower frame. Row4: 1 an open illuminated atlas with one gold page and star clasp; 2 a blacksmith hammer enclosing a bright spark; 3 a miner lamp above a descending stone stair; 4 a battered training shield with THREE bright impact marks; 5 a dark locked book clasp with subtle bronze keyhole; 6 a small quill and emerald ink bottle. Every badge highly legible at small game UI sizes. No lettering, no digits, no captions, no watermark, no scenery, no floor, no user interface, no drop shadows extending beyond cell. Preserve exact 6 by 4 alignment.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original pixel-art fantasy environment illustration for StepQuest, the Chronicles of the Refuge. Wide 16:10 composition. An ancient adventurers' guild scriptorium at blue dusk, a huge beautiful open illuminated chronicle resting on a carved dark oak lectern, deep emerald leather covers, warm parchment pages with decorative star maps and tiny wordless miniature paintings, a quill, wax seals, a small amber lantern, a copper compass and a traveller's patched boots beside the desk. Tall stone arches and dark bookcases behind, distant beacon light visible through a high narrow window, subtle floating golden dust. The open book and lantern dominate the central right part, rich crisp deliberate 32-bit JRPG pixel clusters, moss greens, antique bronze, midnight blue and warm amber. Detailed atmospheric original game illustration, no legible writing, no letters, no numbers, no user interface, no labels, no characters, no logos, no watermark. Full bleed scene, dark quiet edges suitable behind a fantasy game interface.
